verdict.rationale: Clara's first-party API docs explicitly cover creating, updating, locking/unlocking and deleting cards, including immediate-active virtual card issuance. A Card Configurations API adds time, day-of-week and merchant-category controls, plus auto-deletion by end date. A live OpenAPI schema and runnable code examples back the public API. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of setting a spend limit at card creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the card endpoints.
